senses.gloss: वेध् (= व्यथ्) cl. 1. Ā. वेधते, to tremble, quake, Lalit.
1. वे॑ध mfn. (√ विध्) = वेधस्, pious, faithful, AV. (v.l.)
2. वेध m. (√ व्यध्) penetration, piercing, breaking through, breach, opening, perforation, VarBṛS.; Rājat.; Sarvad.
hitting (a mark), MBh.
puncturing, wounding, a wound, Suśr.
a partic. disease of horses, L.
hole, excavation, VarBṛS.
the depth of an excavation, depth, Car. (also in measurement, Col.)
intrusion, disturbance, Vāstuv.
fixing the position of the sun or of the stars, VarBṛS.
mixture of fluids, L.
a partic. process to which quicksilver is subjected, Sarvad.
a partic. measure or division of time (= 100 Truṭis = 1/3 Lava), Pur.
N. of a son of Ananta, VahniP.
वेध , &c. See 2. वेध, p. 1018, col. 1.
वेधा f. a mystical N. of the letter म्, Up.
वेध॑स् mfn. (in some meanings prob. connected with वि-√ धा; nom. m. वेधा॑स् acc. वेध॑सम् or वेधा॑म्) pious, religious, virtuous, good, brave (also applied to gods), RV.; AV.; TS.; MBh.; Hariv.
wise, Kām.
performing, accomplishing (in गम्भीर-व्˚), BhP.
वेध॑स् m. a worshipper of the gods, RV.
an arranger, disposer, creator (esp. applied to Brahmā, but also to Prajāpati, Puruṣa, Śiva, Viṣṇu, Dharma, the Sun &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
an author, Rājat.; Sarvad.
a wise or learned man, L.
N. of the father of Hari-ścandra (see वैदस).
वेध॑स्—तम (वेध॑स्-), mfn. most pious or religious, best, wisest, RV.
वेधस n. the part of the hand under the root of the thumb (considered as sacred to Brahmā; see तीर्थ), L.
वेधस m. N. of a Vedic Ṛṣi (said to belong to the family of Aṅgiras), MW.
वेधसी f. N. of a place of pilgrimage, Cat.
वेधस्या॑ f. (instr.) worship, piety, RV. ix, 82, 2.
वेध—गुप्त m. (in music) a partic. Rāga, Saṃgīt.
वेध—मय mf(ई)n. consisting in perforation or penetration, Cat.
वेध—मुख्य m. Curcuma Zerumbet, L.
वेध—मुख्या f. musk, L.
a civet-cat, L.
वेध—मुख्यक m. Curcuma Zerumbet, L.
वेधक m. a piercer, perforator (of gems &c.), MBh.; R.
camphor, L.
sandal, L.
Rumex Vesicarius, L.
N. of one of the divisions of Naraka (destined for arrow-makers), VP.
वेधक n. coriander, L.
rock-salt, L.
grain, rice in the ear, W.
वेधक &c. See 2. वेध, p. 1018, col. 1.
वेधन n. piercing, hitting (with an arrow), MBh.
penetration, excavation, MW.
affecting with (instr.), Śaṃk.
depth (cf. 2. वेध), MBh.
puncturing, pricking, wounding, MW.
वेधनी f. an auger, gimlet, any piercing instrument (esp. for piercing an elephant's ears), L.
Trigonella Foenum Graecum, L.
वेधनिका f. a sharp-pointed perforating instrument (esp. for piercing jewels or shells), auger, awl, gimlet &c., L.
वेधनीय mfn. capable of being pierced, penetrable, vulnerable, MW.
वेधित mfn. = -विद्ध, pierced, perforated, penetrated, L.
shaken, trembling (applied to the earth), Divyāv.
वेधि-त्व n. (fr. next + त्व) capacity of piercing (see शब्द-व्˚).
वेधिन् mfn. piercing, perforating, hitting (a mark), MBh.; R.
वेधिन् m. Rumex Vesicarius, L.
वेधिनी f. a leech, L.
Trigonella Foenum Graecum, L.
वेध्य mfn. to be pierced or perforated, VarBṛS.; Kathās. &c.
to be cut open or punctured (as a vein; -ता f.), Car.
to be fixed or observed (cf. 2. वेध), Gaṇit.
वेध्य n. a mark for shooting at, butt, target, MārkP.
वेध्या f. a kind of musical instrument, L.
वेध्य—ता f.
